_about: 1-Butanol (1) + Benzene (2): isothermal total pressures at 313.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: Villamanan, R. M., Martin, M. C., Chamorro, C. R.[Cesar R.], Villamanan, M. A.[Miguel Angel], Segovia, J. J.[Jose J.], Phase equilibrium properties of binary and ternary systems containing di-isopropyl ether + 1-butanol + benzene at 313.15 K, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 38 (2006) 547-553
